scope: Concrete simulation inputs for paper-derived manipulation tasks

robot_limits.rationale: Use the pinned robot and its actual joint limits.

value.axes: x right, y away from robot, z up

station_frames.rationale: Separate station workspaces; poses are layout selections, not the historical laboratory.

grasps.rationale: Named contact regions are refined into task-specific approach frames by each physical workcell.

value.payload_retainer: four adjustable corner stops and passive latch

docks.rationale: A carrier retains the apparatus during transfers; release cannot be inferred from arrival alone.

value.transport_between_stations: external mobile-base motion; load and unload remain robot manipulation

collision_routes.rationale: Resolve manipulation locally and retain physical object identity across station handoffs.

outdoor_weather_limits.rationale: Selected environment envelope for the simulation scenario; not a manufacturer outdoor rating.

value.machine_access: output disabled and spindle/jet stationary before opening
value.electrical_transfer: source output off and readback below 1 V

interlocks.rationale: Explicit environment states precede physical access; they never prove the hand motion.

lots.rationale: Synthetic inventory identifiers preserve lineage without inventing historical batch numbers.

condition_assignment.rationale: The mapping branch uses the white apparatus; preserve separate white/black identities.

independent_specimen_count.rationale: One white and one black specimen in this selected demonstration, not an inference about the paper sample count.

session_count.rationale: Calibration, optical and six outdoor sessions are separately identified.

technical_repeats.rationale: One execution of each specified configuration is the nominal manipulation sample.

reuse_policy.rationale: Do not relabel a newly created object as an earlier retained specimen.

value.then: stop dependent occurrence and preserve failure receipt

attempt_schedule.rationale: Bound recovery explicitly; failed attempts remain in the dataset.

part_manifest.rationale: Keep reported dimensions and append separately named reconstruction choices.

drawing_revision.rationale: Version the selected geometry independently of the source publication.

actual_dimensions.rationale: Selected dimensions used by the workcells; these are design values, not measured manufactured parts.

tolerances.rationale: Explicit nominal inspection targets; each run must observe geometry before acceptance.

value.physical_task: load, clamp, close, operate controls, open, unclamp and unload

qualified_machine_settings.rationale: Internal cutting is a device process. No unreported nozzle pressure, feed rate or real-machine qualification is fabricated.

coating_cure.rationale: Three coats are reported; timing and ambient conditions are selected simulation assumptions.

inspection.rationale: Inspections observe the physical item, not the operation label.

safe_release.rationale: Release requires device isolation and an independently supported item.

component_join_map.rationale: An explicit support graph includes the membrane load path; the larger cover bore cannot rest directly on the PE rim.

film_gap.rationale: Two separate sheets enclose the reported spacer thickness.

reflector_height_and_datum.rationale: Use the reported approximate separation as a concrete selected design datum.

value.heater_policy: retain full 50.8 mm commercial outline; support the 50 mm bonded area and keep the overhang free
value.thermocouple_policy: 0.3 mm deep local foam recess retains the rear-centre bead beneath the heater; no heater cutting

selected_geometry_and_unresolved_conflic.rationale: Preserve source dimensions instead of silently resizing incompatible components; attachment and recess details are inferred.

site_date_window.rationale: A selected Cambridge summer scenario defines a track; it is not a claim about the paper measurement date.

track_or_band_path.rationale: Both reflector paths derive from the same selected solar geometry; an illustrative curve is insufficient.

value.check: all aperture points shaded at all scheduled samples

shadow_acceptance.rationale: Validate the geometric shadow independently of temperature or paper results.

sensor_serials.rationale: Synthetic identities are not vendor serial numbers.

reference_id.rationale: Use the exact paper model represented by assets/omega_pm_rtd_v1.

bath_setpoints.rationale: Selected temperature states exercise loading, controls and retrieval; they do not reproduce historical readings.

equilibrium_predicate.rationale: Explicit simulated process gate; independent of manipulation acceptance.

fit_method.value: linear offset and slope regression against four-wire RTD
fit_method.rationale: Source describes offset correction and propagation of slope error.

value.physical_installation: probe remains seated and cable retained after gripper release

acceptance.rationale: Keep process checks separate from physical placement checks.

value.identity: sensor + extension + DAQ channel + calibration revision

validity.rationale: Changing a lead or connector invalidates that path calibration.

copper_block_hole_drawing.rationale: Paper reports a drilled isothermal block; bore sizes and arrangement are selected.

bath_fluid_and_fill_range.rationale: Water is reported; selected support and fill envelope keep wire terminations out of the bath.

probe_to_channel_map.rationale: Eight thermocouple channels receive two emitters and six additional map probes.

probe_to_hole_map.rationale: Each probe has a unique assigned bore.

value.transition: K-compatible miniature connector with conductor-specific crimp contacts
value.qualification: whole-path synthetic calibration plus observed retention; no hardware qualification

fine_wire_transition_and_qualification.rationale: The USB-TC accepts AWG16–30, so AWG36 cannot be treated as a qualified direct screw-terminal connection.

sample_mount.rationale: A selected coupon covers the manufacturer-described FTIR sample port without grasping the optical centre.

reference.rationale: Use the device-specific reference and preserve its identity.

scan_parameters.rationale: Concrete simulated scan settings; no scientific result is inferred from completion.

spectral_windows.rationale: Selected process windows cover the paper-relevant solar and infrared regions.

repeat_count.rationale: Nominal manipulation scenario uses one mount/scan/unload per configuration.

processing_assumptions.rationale: Device outputs are observations of the simulated environment, never desired paper outcomes.

site_coordinates.rationale: Selected site in Cambridge; not the measured rooftop coordinates.

timezone.rationale: Use the selected site timezone and explicit UTC records.

local_and_UTC_schedule.rationale: Sessions are selected tasks; timestamps derive from the ephemeris and timezone.

value.method: minimize solar zenith over selected local date

solar_noon.rationale: Compute instead of hard-coding noon to 12:00.

orientation.rationale: The fixture frame must agree with the solar geometry frame.

shadow_inspection.rationale: Check geometric shading rather than temperature sign.

tracking_cadence.rationale: Selected one-minute carriage adjustments bound interpolation error.

weather_eligibility.rationale: These are simulator condition assignments, not claimed historical weather measurements.

abort_limits.rationale: Selected task envelope triggers a safe supported stop.

channel_map.rationale: Stable physical channel identities are shared with calibration.

units.rationale: Record units with every synthetic stream.

sensor_geometry.rationale: Use named contact regions and model-specific insertion datums.

sampling_cadence_by_device.rationale: Weather cadence is source-reported; other cadences are explicit selections.

clock_sync_tolerance.rationale: Selected maximum timestamp mismatch in seconds.

raw_sink.rationale: Store raw simulated outputs separately from physical receipts.

missing_data_rule.rationale: Do not silently replace missing observations.

mount_receipt.rationale: A selected mount specification is not a successful attachment receipt.

value.sense_tap: heater-side ends of both 305 mm heater leads

four_wire_port_graph.rationale: Separate force and sense conductors meet at each heater node, not at the source meter.

current_power_temperature_limits.rationale: Conservative selected simulated operating envelope; no hardware safety certification.

independent_cutoff.rationale: A separate simulated device state must interrupt the circuit.

strain_relief.rationale: Route leads away from the thin emitter edge and provide a selected service loop.

nonempty_targets.rationale: Selected synthetic temperature offsets exercise all manipulation contexts.

gains.rationale: Selected process-model controller; no claim of apparatus tuning.

summary_window_s.rationale: Use the final two minutes of the plateau.

stability_predicate.rationale: Selected synthetic process acceptance, excluded from manipulation scoring.

controller_revision.rationale: Keep process model revision distinct from robot controller revision.

seven_location_bindings.rationale: Preserve all seven distinct source-related contact roles.

six_extra_sensor_coordinates.rationale: Coordinates are inferred from the source cross-section and separately marked in sensor_installation.json.

attachment_tolerances.rationale: Selected contact-placement and retention limits for fine wires.

value.selection: last complete stable interval after lid removal

average_window_rule.rationale: Do not choose intervals by matching the paper temperature.

baseline_timing_within_total_session.rationale: Five-minute baseline is explicitly inferred for mapping; source stagnation timing does not automatically transfer.

value.remaining_interval: after successful release and equilibrium until t=3600

open_lid_and_equilibrium_interval_select.rationale: Actual manipulation duration is included in the one-hour session.

emitter_area_m2.rationale: Area follows the reported 50 mm emitter; not the 50.8 mm heater.

interval_selection.rationale: Keep reporting choices independent of the desired scientific result.

invalid_interval_policy.value: retain raw stream and mark invalid
invalid_interval_policy.rationale: Missing evidence never becomes a successful manipulation.

uncertainty_budget.rationale: Do not fabricate measured uncertainty for a simulated task.

ambient_equal_estimate_rule.value: interpolate between bracketing synthetic PID points; no extrapolation
ambient_equal_estimate_rule.rationale: A deterministic reporting rule, outside manipulation scoring.

safe_temperature.rationale: Selected maximum handling temperature in degrees Celsius.

isolation_readback.rationale: Read observed device state before disconnecting or unloading.

storage.rationale: Each returned object has a named support and identity.

residue_cleaning.rationale: A selected dry-cleaning manipulation avoids inventing chemistry compatibility.

waste_routes.rationale: Track each consumed or rejected object by identity.

object_instance_map.rationale: The same object persists through loading, manipulation and return.

interface_to_instance_map.rationale: A role name alone is not a physical binding.

tool_and_fixture_ids.rationale: Selected tools expose their geometry, inertia and contact limits in workcell models.

contact_regions_and_approach_frames.rationale: Use observation and station-specific approach frames to keep wires clear of closing jaws.

support_and_retention_checks.rationale: Support is measured from contact forces after release, not asserted by the action name.

force_torque_clearance_limits.rationale: Selected simulation controller limits; contact damage of physical materials remains uncalibrated.

conditional_step_dispositions.rationale: No branch or repeated occurrence receives credit from another branch automatically.

forbidden: change collision mask to suppress fault

bounded_recovery_policy.rationale: Recovery remains physical and is recorded as an additional attempt.
